name: sam_adeyemi
title: AI Engineer
job_desc:
AI Engineer - Northstar AI (Chicago, Hybrid)
We build AI assistants for insurance and financial services teams.
You will: build LLM features end to end, from prompt design to production APIs; build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over large document sets with embeddings and vector databases; design evaluations to measure quality and catch regressions; build tool-using agents; work with customers to turn workflows into AI products.
Requirements: 3+ years software engineering; Python and TypeScript; hands-on experience shipping LLM features (OpenAI or Anthropic APIs); RAG and vector databases; evaluation of LLM output; fine-tuning a plus; insurance or fintech domain a plus.

interview.question: How would you know if your RAG system is giving wrong answers?
interview.answer: I would test it with some questions and see if the answers look right. Users can also report bad answers. Then I would tweak the prompt.
